title: refs must let slice text mark a reference as an example
lead: `slicer refs` checks every `path:line` it finds. Slice text that quotes example references, for instance a spec for `refs` itself, therefore always reports `missing_file`, and `refs` can never exit 0 for that item. There needs to be a way to say "this is an example, not a reference".
findings_note: first slicer refs run on main, 2026-10-11: 6 of 7 reports were s248's example refs; no way to silence them
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the shared-line anchor rule (s248); config-level ignore lists; changing which text refs scans.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
On 2026-10-11, the first run of `slicer refs` on main after s246 landed reported 7 problems. 6 of them came from the example lines in s248's own spec (`src/app.py:1`, `a.py:5`, ...), and nothing could silence them. If an example counts as drift, `refs` becomes noise exactly in the specs that describe it. <!-- example -->

**Decision (owner, final): option (c), both rules apply.**

1. References inside fenced code blocks are skipped. Fences open with ``` or ~~~ (optionally indented up to 3 spaces). A fence closes on a line of the same character, at least as long as the opener, with nothing after it but spaces or tabs, up to 3 spaces in. A backtick opener's info string may not contain a backtick.
2. Every reference on a line that contains the HTML comment `<!-- example -->` is skipped.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/refs.py`: the pure parser skips references according to the chosen rule.
- `tests/test_refs.py`.
- `docs/commands.md`: state the rule. `CHANGELOG.md`.
- s248's spec: mark its examples, through `slicer edit`, once this lands.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `test_Find_FencedBlock_IsSkipped` (if (a) or (c) is chosen).
2. `test_Find_ExampleMarker_SkipsWholeLine` (if (b) or (c) is chosen).
3. `test_Find_UnmarkedLine_StillParsed`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. The owner picks (a), (b) or (c). Record the choice in Why with `slicer edit`.
2. Write the tests and watch them fail.
3. Change the parser, then the docs.
4. Run `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite, then `slicer check`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`.
- After s248's examples are marked, `slicer refs` on this roadmap no longer reports them.
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `feature/s249-refs-examples` in `.worktrees/s249`. Do not commit, merge or push until the owner asks. This repo finishes with `handoff`.
